problem.title: Range Sum Query - Immutable
problem.problemStatement: Given an integer array and multiple range sum queries, return the sum of elements between indices left and right (inclusive) for each query. Preprocess the array using a prefix sum array to answer each query efficiently.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums Integer q q queries (left, right)
problem.output: For each query, print the range sum.
